/-- [artifactkeeper_kernel::handlers::create_permission]:
    Source: 'src/handlers.rs', lines 132:0-161:1
    Visibility: public -/
def handlers.create_permission
  (db : tables.Db) (oracle : trusted.Oracle) (auth : Option AuthExtension)
  (payload : handlers.CreatePermissionRequest) :
  Result ((alloc.vec.Vec resolve.Write) × (core.result.Result Unit AppError))
  := do
  let r ← handlers.create_permission_gates db oracle auth payload
  match r with
  | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
    let b ← tables.Db.fails db tables.Query.InsertPermission
    if b
    then
      ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, core.result.Result.Err
        AppError.Database)
    else
      let b1 ← handlers.duplicate db payload
      if b1
      then
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, core.result.Result.Err
          AppError.Conflict)
      else
        let allowed_cidrs ←
          match payload.conditions with
          | none => ok none
          | some c =>
            match c.allowed_cidrs with
            | none => ok none
            | some cidrs =>
              do
              let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref cidrs
              let v ← handlers.parse_cidrs oracle s
              ok (some v)
        let v ←
          alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 payload.principal_type
        let v1 ←
          alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 payload.target_type
        let v2 ←
          alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec
            core.clone.CloneU8) payload.actions
        let writes ←
          alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
            (resolve.Write.InsertPermission
            {
              principal_type := v,
              principal_id := payload.principal_id,
              target_type := v1,
              target_id := payload.target_id,
              actions := v2,
              allowed_cidrs
            })
        ok (writes, core.result.Result.Ok ())
  | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, r)

/-- [artifactkeeper_kernel::handlers::create_permission_gates]:
    Source: 'src/handlers.rs', lines 163:0-174:1 -/
def handlers.create_permission_gates
  (db : tables.Db) (oracle : trusted.Oracle) (auth : Option AuthExtension)
  (payload : handlers.CreatePermissionRequest) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit AppError)
  := do
  let r ← handlers.require_auth auth
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let s ←
      lift (Array.to_slice
        (Array.make 5#usize [ 119#u8, 114#u8, 105#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8 ]))
    let r1 ← token_scope.AuthExtension.require_scope val s
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      let r2 ← token_scope.AuthExtension.require_admin val
      let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref payload.principal_type
        let r3 ← permission.validate_principal db s1 payload.principal_id
        let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
        match cf3 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
          match payload.conditions with
          | none =>
            let r4 ← handlers.validate_anonymous_rule payload
            let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
            match cf4 with
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
              ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
                Unit (core.convert.FromSame AppError) residual
          | some conditions =>
            let r4 ←
              permission.validate_conditions oracle conditions.allowed_cidrs
            let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
            match cf4 with
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
              let r5 ← handlers.validate_anonymous_rule payload
              let cf5 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r5
              match cf5 with
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
                ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
                  Unit (core.convert.FromSame AppError) residual
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
                Unit (core.convert.FromSame AppError) residual
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
            Unit (core.convert.FromSame AppError) residual
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
          Unit (core.convert.FromSame AppError) residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
        Unit (core.convert.FromSame AppError) residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
      Unit (core.convert.FromSame AppError) residual

import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result artifactkeeper_kernel artifactkeeper_kernel.Spec H5iAppLib

namespace artifactkeeper_kernel.Solution

@[simp] theorem coe_vec_new (α : Type _) : (↑(alloc.vec.Vec.new α) : List α) = [] := by
  simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new]

@[simp] theorem from_residual_not_ok {T E F : Type} (inst : core.convert.From F E) (r : core.result.Result Never E) (x : T) :
    (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual T inst r = ok (core.result.Result.Ok x)) ↔ False := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases r with
    | Ok n => cases n
    | Err e =>
      unfold core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual at h
      obtain ⟨v, hv, h2⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
      simp at h2
  · intro h; cases h

theorem branch_continue {T E : Type} {r : core.result.Result T E} {v : T}
    (h : core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r = ok (core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue v)) :
    r = core.result.Result.Ok v := by
  cases r with
  | Ok x => simp [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at h; subst h; rfl
  | Err e => simp [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at h

theorem require_admin_true (val : AuthExtension)
    (h : token_scope.AuthExtension.require_admin val = ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())) :
    val.is_admin = true := by
  unfold token_scope.AuthExtension.require_admin at h
  split at h
  · assumption
  · simp at h

theorem duplicate_is_admin (self val : AuthExtension)
    (h : AuthExtension.duplicate self = ok val) :
    val.is_admin = self.is_admin := by
  unfold AuthExtension.duplicate at h
  h5i_invert h
  rfl

theorem require_auth_admin (auth : Option AuthExtension) (val : AuthExtension)
    (h : handlers.require_auth auth = ok (core.result.Result.Ok val)) :
    ∃ ext, auth = some ext ∧ val.is_admin = ext.is_admin := by
  unfold handlers.require_auth at h
  cases auth with
  | none => simp at h
  | some ext =>
    h5i_invert h
    exact ⟨ext, rfl, duplicate_is_admin ext val h⟩

theorem create_permission_gates_admin (db : tables.Db) (o : trusted.Oracle) (auth : Option AuthExtension)
    (p : handlers.CreatePermissionRequest) (a : Unit)
    (h : handlers.create_permission_gates db o auth p = ok (core.result.Result.Ok a)) :
    ∃ e, auth = some e ∧ e.is_admin = true := by
  unfold handlers.create_permission_gates at h
  rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := h
  rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨cf, hcf, h⟩ := h
  cases cf with
  | Break res =>
    simp [from_residual_not_ok] at h
  | Continue val =>
    rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := h
    rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨r1, hr1, h⟩ := h
    rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨cf1, hcf1, h⟩ := h
    cases cf1 with
    | Break res1 =>
      simp [from_residual_not_ok] at h
    | Continue _ =>
      rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨r2, hr2, h⟩ := h
      rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨cf2, hcf2, h⟩ := h
      cases cf2 with
      | Break res2 =>
        simp [from_residual_not_ok] at h
      | Continue u =>
        have hr_ok := branch_continue hcf
        rw [hr_ok] at hr
        have hr2_ok : r2 = .Ok () := by
          cases u
          exact branch_continue hcf2
        rw [hr2_ok] at hr2
        have hadm := require_admin_true val hr2
        obtain ⟨ext, hext, hadm_ext⟩ := require_auth_admin auth val hr
        exact ⟨ext, hext, hadm_ext ▸ hadm⟩

theorem only_admin_creates_rules (db : tables.Db) (o : trusted.Oracle) (auth : Option AuthExtension)
    (p : handlers.CreatePermissionRequest) (ws : alloc.vec.Vec resolve.Write) (r : core.result.Result Unit AppError)
    (h : handlers.create_permission db o auth p = ok (ws, r)) (hw : ws.val ≠ []) :
    ∃ e, auth = some e ∧ e.is_admin = true := by
  unfold handlers.create_permission at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    subst_vars
    try simp at hw
  obtain ⟨a, hgates⟩ : ∃ a, handlers.create_permission_gates db o auth p = ok (core.result.Result.Ok a) := ⟨_, by assumption⟩
  exact create_permission_gates_admin db o auth p a hgates

end artifactkeeper_kernel.Solution

@[simp] lemma never_rec_eq_false {A} (x : Never) (v : A) : (Never.rec (fun _ => A) x = v) = False := nomatch x

lemma strip_bind {A E : Type} {e : Result A} {v : A} (h : (do let x ← e; ok (@core.result.Result.Ok A E x)) = ok (core.result.Result.Ok v)) : e = ok v := by
  cases he : e
  · rename_i x
    simp_all
  · rename_i x
    simp_all
  · simp_all

@[simp]
lemma duplicate_is_admin (ext val : AuthExtension) (h : (do let ae ← ext.duplicate; ok (@core.result.Result.Ok AuthExtension AppError ae)) = ok (core.result.Result.Ok val)) : ext.is_admin = val.is_admin := by
  have h1 := strip_bind h
  unfold AuthExtension.duplicate at h1
  h5i_invert h1
  rfl

lemma admin_of_gates {db o auth p a} (h : handlers.create_permission_gates db o auth p = ok (core.result.Result.Ok a)) :
  ∃ e, auth = some e ∧ e.is_admin = true := by
  unfold handlers.create_permission_gates at h
  unfold handlers.require_auth at h
  unfold token_scope.AuthExtension.require_admin at h
  unfold core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch at h
  unfold core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual at h
  h5i_invert h <;> {
    try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
    try split at * <;> try simp_all
  }

theorem only_admin_creates_rules (db : tables.Db) (o : trusted.Oracle) (auth : Option AuthExtension)
    (p : handlers.CreatePermissionRequest) (ws : alloc.vec.Vec resolve.Write) (r : core.result.Result Unit AppError)
    (h : handlers.create_permission db o auth p = ok (ws, r)) (hw : ws.val ≠ []) :
    ∃ e, auth = some e ∧ e.is_admin = true := by
  unfold handlers.create_permission at h
  h5i_invert h <;> try { subst ws; contradiction }
  -- Only the successful branch remains.
  apply admin_of_gates (a := _)
  assumption

end artifactkeeper_kernel.Solution
